verdict.rationale: Ultrametric holds hosted company records, so data export applies. Records, runs and history can be read programmatically as JSON through the CLI (`context get --record ... --history --json`) and an HTTP API with an OpenAPI contract, which would let a user script their own extraction. There is no documented bulk export or exit path, and the 'your company comes with you' claim is about switching AI models, not leaving Ultrametric. missing for 10: a documented export-all feature, explicit open export formats covering all records and documents, account exit/deletion guidance, independent corroboration.
